description: Fetch one form's settings by hash or URL title — name, description, confirmation message, notification emails, public flag, language, start/end dates, entry limit and links. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

name: wufoo_get_form
title: Get one form
